name: Large-Scale Transportation Systems Optimization
description: This course is designed to introduce optimization methods that are useful in solving large-scale transportation problems. Topics include mathematical programming formulation of famous optimization models arising in planning of transportation systems, introduction to computational complexity, proving problems as NP-complete, dynamic programming, principle of optimality, the simplex method, polyhedral theory for understanding polyhedral structure of famous transportation related optimization models, large-scale integer programming methods such as subgradient method, column generation, benders decomposition, branch-and-bound, cutting plane method, branch-and-cut, and branch-and-price and introduction to linear bi-level programming problems.
